image.name: Bruce Power
image.description: Bruce Power operates eight CANDU nuclear generating units at the leased Bruce site in Ontario and supplies roughly 30% of the province's electricity together with medical isotopes. Ontario Power Generation owns and leases the site and is not a Bruce Power equity owner; station units, refurbishment programs, isotope ventures, contracts and financing entities remain beneath the single platform boundary.

image.description: Skyway Concession Company LLC is the concessionaire and operator of the Chicago Skyway, a 7.8-mile, six-lane toll road linking Chicago's Dan Ryan Expressway with the Indiana Toll Road. image.name: Intersect Power
image.subsector: Co-located power and data-center infrastructure development
image.description: Intersect Power is a U.S. digital-power infrastructure platform that develops co-located land, data-center shells, solar generation, battery storage and hybrid firming solutions for hyperscale cloud, AI and other energy-intensive customers. Google acquired the company on March 10, 2026 for US$4.75 billion, after making a minority investment in December 2024. The acquired company includes the Intersect team, digital-power business and specified co-located projects. Separate grid-tied operating and development assets were carved out into IPX Power and are not part of this PortCo. Former Intersect investors included Climate Adaptive Infrastructure, Greenbelt/Trilantic, TPG Rise Climate and Pantheon Infrastructure. Intersect reports a historical track record exceeding US$20 billion and 11.5 GW across 14 facilities, including legacy assets now assigned to IPX. No later sale or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.

image.name: Budderfly
image.subsector: Distributed energy-as-a-service and virtual power plants
image.description: Budderfly, Inc. is a U.S. energy-as-a-service platform that finances, installs, owns, monitors and maintains energy-efficiency and distributed-energy equipment under long-term customer contracts. Its solutions include HVAC, lighting, refrigeration, controls, solar, battery storage and virtual-power-plant capabilities for restaurants, retail, fitness, healthcare, hospitality, schools and manufacturing customers. Budderfly reports more than 8,500 customer locations nationwide, over US$248 million invested and average annual energy savings of approximately 22%. Partners Group completed a majority acquisition through Encore Holdings LP in July 2022 and committed more than US$500 million of growth capital; company management retained minority rollover equity. Edison Partners and Balance Point Capital are recorded as former investors. EnergyCloud is a product, Encore is the holding layer, and individual sites and acquired assets are not separate PortCos. No later sponsor exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
